sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single Scout returned one unified candidate table across llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; main agent selected arXiv:2608.11715v1 for post-training depth and low duplicate risk.
Main Agent read the arXiv abstract, HTML, PDF text extraction, tables, formulas, appendices, prompt ablation, and external search results.
Article explains ALM formulation, hierarchical metrics, SFT/PPO/GRPO objectives, RM-1/RM-2/RM-3 rewards, experiment settings, tables, and limitations.
Review separates supported claims from boundaries: translated benchmark, limited language coverage, judge and matching ambiguity, and task-specific RL conclusions.
External search found mostly arXiv and index pages; no stronger third-party technical analysis was used beyond official paper evidence.
Article is pure Markdown with more than 5000 Chinese characters, no external image embeds, and evidence represented through tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid.
